name: China economy
summary: China's official manufacturing PMI fell to 49.3 in October; growth near target, no contagion
state: China's official manufacturing PMI fell to 49.3 in October, below the 50 line, and the other official indices also slipped under 50 (National Bureau of Statistics, 3 Nov; Trading Economics). Growth was near the official target in Q3, and no new property-developer default wave or financial contagion had been reported as of 7 Nov. Normal holds under hysteresis, but momentum is weakening.
for_you: Weaker Chinese demand tends to weigh on commodity exporters and on firms selling into China.
rubric_hit: Growth near target, no contagion = Normal; deflation or developer defaults (Watch) not confirmed

sources.title: National Bureau of Statistics — Purchasing Managers' Index for October 2026
Trading Economics — China manufacturing unexpectedly weakens

why: China is the world's factory and the biggest marginal buyer of commodities; a hard landing would ripple through every supply chain.
drivers: Property sector, local-government debt, exports and tariffs, deflation, stimulus.

rubric.alert: Hard landing (growth < 3%), financial contagion, or capital controls tightened sharply.
rubric.watch: Deflation, renewed property-developer defaults, or growth clearly below target.
rubric.normal: Growth near official target, stable property sales, no financial contagion.
